orientation: All runtime images top-down, flipY=true. Normal and roughness use linear data; diffuse uses sRGB.
conversion: EXR rows corrected vertically; 2x2 average and normal renormalization; lossless WebP normal/roughness/mask.
blend: Prebaked spatial mask: fractal value noise, exact road distance, rock proximity, slope, height, cliff distance. Full rocky interiors; feathered transitions; shared albedo/normal/roughness mask.
